viewing_check: Inspect under the glass or remove the backing if allowed: is the image printed (halftone dots or even ink dots under a loupe, no paper cockling or brush texture) or true watercolour? Read the signature at lower right, check for pencil edition number, title and signature below the image on the mount, and the backing label for gallery or publisher details. Photograph the signature and any labels.
rate_note: All results in AUD; no conversion needed (one Pasarel USD result omitted).
